name: place_held_at_target_servo
description: Closed-loop visual-servo PLACE. While still holding an object at a hover, iteratively grounds the held object and the target with Grounded-SAM, unprojects both to world xy, and nudges the arm by the residual until the held object is within tol_m of the target — then descends and releases. Closes the ~4 cm open-loop placement gap that fails tight-alignment tasks (match_blocks).
